Best AI App I’ve encountered so far. So many of these types of apps out there it’s always a gamble to determine what the quality of image conversion will be. And I must say I’ve been happiest with AI Mirror most especially it’s DIY Lab! I’ve fed my pics and my bf’s into the app and they bear a strong enough resemblance in both cases although maybe a little more “idealized” and whitewashed than I’d prefer but most definitely us. (In my case, the Lab enlongated my short neck and hasn’t quite captured my upturned nose.) A slider in the Lab would be helpful in terms of having the option to create a more faithful interpretation vs one where more liberties are allowed. 

That being said, I use the DIY Lab to create characters based on photos and, in those cases, I don’t mind the slight variations as I don’t want exact replicas of the original pic. What I do love is that the character generated is consistent from rendering to rendering, and continues to look like the same person each time (with an allowance for the occasional AI hiccup). 

What I would like to see more of: diversity of skin color, hair texture and body type. There’s already been some improvement, so I know this is something they’re working on, but it’s not coming fast enough for those of us who want to feature darker skin, tight curls, natural hairstlyes, and thicker bodies. For women especially, I’ve noticed a tendency for the Lab to lighten skin tone and relax curls, and it would behoove the developers to understand that whitewashing is not a feature but rather a bug, and one best remedied sooner rather than later.
